title: Citizenship of persons and entities
summary: Citizenship identifies the legally relevant state or foreign affiliation of a party for diversity jurisdiction. It depends on the kind of party rather than a single universal test.
notes: Residence, a business address, or extensive operations may be insufficient. An entity’s citizenship for subject-matter jurisdiction also differs from its contacts or corporate home for personal jurisdiction.

sections.Meaning: Citizenship identifies the legally relevant state or foreign affiliation of a party for diversity jurisdiction. It depends on the kind of party rather than a single universal test.
sections.How to work through the question: Natural-person citizenship uses domicile in the assigned cases. A corporation has the statutory places of citizenship discussed in the text, including its principal place of business. Unincorporated associations generally require examining members’ citizenship. Verify the entity’s legal form before applying a corporate rule.
